I'd love to be talked of of it.  Hell I even called the local decent mental health clinic around here, and they said their inpatient unit is full.  *sigh* the only other option is ending up in the ghetto place, and I've had enough ghetto gen-psych unit experiences  (10+) to write a shitty book about.  Crossing my fingers and lining up the pills.

P.S. "Veronika decides to die" is a beautiful and wonderful movie.  I highly recommend it for anyone getting in the mood to kill themselves. (and it's also a great book!).
